stories.title: Parents fighting to save school accuse Flintshire council of scaremongering
stories.summary: Parents battling to save their school from closure have said Flintshire County Council is scaremongering to justify its proposed £55m Catholic super-school. stories.title: Overdue boat found safe at Greenfield Docks after Dee estuary search
